title: Observability: update/finalize failure logs omit provider name
description: crypto2dev_fd_write() line 397 logs 'write(algo): update failed: errno' and ioctl_finalize() line 1168 logs 'finalize(algo): failed: errno'. Neither message includes the provider name. In a multi-provider deployment (e.g., wolfssl + kcapi both loaded), the support engineer cannot determine from the log which provider handled the failing session. state->provider_name is available in the fd state at both call sites. File: src/cdev/crypto2dev_fd.c lines 397, 1168. Fix: include state->provider_name in both log messages, e.g. 'write(algo/provider): update failed: errno'.
